items.title: METR red-teams OpenAI's internal agent monitoring systems
items.summary_en: METR, working with Redwood Research, spent about three weeks in July-August stress-testing OpenAI's internal agent monitoring. METR reports finding several vulnerabilities. OpenAI says it has patched those affecting production safeguards, and METR says it has not verified OpenAI's claims about later coverage changes.
items.notes: Page could not be fetched (metr.org DNS failure); details from search-result excerpts only. Full internal report (reportedly 61 pages) shared only with OpenAI staff; METR is publishing a subset. OpenAI's patch claims unverified by METR.

items.title: METR publishes external review of Anthropic's August 2026 Risk Report
items.summary_en: METR reviewed the 'Misalignment in high-stakes settings' section of Anthropic's August 2026 Risk Report. The review is listed under METR's partnership work.
items.notes: Only the listing page was surfaced; specific review URL and conclusions not seen. Do not report findings until the review itself is read.

items.title: METR proposes how outside assessors could examine frontier AI risk
items.summary_en: On 2026-10-14 METR published several methodology proposals. They cover how an assessor could investigate evidence of AI R&D acceleration, control and monitoring of internal AI agents, and a way to better inform the public about loss-of-control risks. A related post describes METR's approach to working with AI companies.
items.notes: Pages not fetched; titles and search excerpts only. Proposals, not empirical findings.
